question: Does Sobol-Shoemake N=64 q0 + joint LM polish at bracket omega-cells recover truth across seed classes, including narrow-basin seed 28?
hypothesis: Sobol+LM recovers Band A on medium / narrow-basin / favorable seed classes, robust to the bracket omega-mag offset.
narrative_md: Sobol-Shoemake N=64 + joint LM recovers all three tested seed classes at 8-9/64 Band A. The 5.64% bracket omega-mag offset is invisible (9/64 at both L0 truth-omega and L1 bracket cell — LM bridges the gap to +0.0003%). The s006 'narrow basin' (~2deg) described the hi-fi rho<2 region width, NOT the ~30-60deg LM convergence radius. Phi-sweep is dead as the IC primitive; Sobol+LM replaces it and validates the bracket->Sobol->LM->hi-fi architecture (at a single cell).
